title: Add real integration test suite

context.summary: Replace the placeholder pnpm test path with real integration tests for the MVP runtime.
context.background: pnpm check and live acceptance pass, but pnpm test currently reports that no runtime tests are defined. A working MVP needs repeatable tests for API, repositories, worker pipeline and jobs.

in: Select and configure a test runner compatible with the monorepo.
Add integration test setup for PostgreSQL and Redis.
Test repositories, auth enforcement, document upload, job lifecycle and context build.
Test worker processing against local object storage and BullMQ.
Make pnpm test fail on real regressions instead of acting as a placeholder.
Document test prerequisites and local commands.
out: Require external embedding providers for the default test suite.
Replace live MVP acceptance with unit tests only.

acceptance_criteria: pnpm test runs a real test suite.
Tests can create isolated database state and clean up after themselves.
Tests cover document upload through worker processing at least to chunked status with embeddings disabled.
Tests cover memory/context build with source references.

manual_checks: Confirm tests do not depend on developer-local persistent state.

risks: Tests can become flaky if they depend on shared Docker volumes or long-running worker timing.
External provider dependencies would make the default suite unreliable.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
